model.title: Expedited Access to Biosimilars Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY)

summary.text: The bill would remove requirements for certain clinical studies on immunogenicity, pharmacodynamics, and comparative clinical effectiveness when manufacturers seek approval for biosimilar drugs—cheaper alternatives to existing biologic medications. This change aims to streamline and expedite the approval process for these follow-on biological products.
